headline: Rays Close Out the ALCS
caption:
The Tampa Bay Rays are ALCS champions, finishing off the Cleveland Guardians 4-2.

Our model picked Tampa Bay before the series with a 56% chance, so this one goes down as a hit. It projected a 4-3 series, and the Rays needed one fewer game than that. A 56% pick is close to a coin flip, which makes calling it right a little sweeter.

That puts the model at 7 of 9 on series picks so far this postseason.

Did you see the Rays winning this one, or were you riding with Cleveland?
